valid.name: complete-ir-surface
valid.source:
(module demo.surface
  (import "host-library" :default Host create-view)
  (import "host-namespace" :as HostNS)
  (import-portable "./helper.eli" helper)
  (defvar counter 0)
  (defconst answer 42)
  (defun exercise (target key ready items)
    (let ((plain 1) lone)
      (let* ((next (+ plain answer)))
        (setq counter next)
        (set! counter (1+ counter))
        (while ready (setq ready false))
        (vector
          nil t false undefined 1 "x" :kw
          '(alpha :beta [1 undefined])
          (lambda (value) value)
          (if ready plain next)
          (when ready plain next)
          (unless ready plain)
          (cond (ready plain next) (t answer))
          (progn plain next)
          (do plain next)
          (and ready plain)
          (or ready next)
          (not ready)
          (nil? nil)
          (undefined? undefined)
          (nullish? false)
          (null undefined)
          (hash-map "plain" plain "next" next)
          (hash-set plain next)
          (list plain next)
          (js-array plain next)
          (js-object :plain plain :next next)
          (js-object :fixed plain "text" next literal-key answer key plain)
          (get target key)
          (put target key plain)
          (js-call target :run plain)
          (new Host plain)
          (js* "globalThis")
          (print plain)
          (str plain)
          (funcall target plain)
          (apply target items)
          (target plain)
          ((get target key) plain)
          (create-view "main" (js-object :className "ready") plain)
          (create-view HostNS plain next)))))
  (export Host HostNS create-view counter answer exercise)
  (export-default exercise)
  answer)

valid.name: portable-bit-operations
valid.source:
(defportable bit-operations (value distance)
  (js-array
   (int32 value)
   (uint32 value)
   (imul32 value 31)
   (bit-and value 255)
   (bit-or value 256)
   (bit-xor value 85)
   (bit-not value)
   (bit-shift-left value distance)
   (bit-shift-right value distance)
   (unsigned-bit-shift-right value distance)))
(export bit-operations)

valid.source:
(defun collect (required &optional optional &rest rest)

valid.name: async-functions-and-await
valid.source:
(defasync resolve-value (value &optional transform)
  (let ((resolved (await value)))
    (if transform (await (funcall transform resolved)) resolved)))
(defconst delayed-double
  (async (value) (* (await value) 2)))
(export resolve-value delayed-double)

valid.name: stack-safe-loop-and-recur
valid.source:
(defun triangular (n acc)
  (if (= n 0) acc (recur (1- n) (+ acc n))))
(defconst swapped
  (loop ((left 1) (right 2) (steps 1))
    (if (= steps 0) [left right]
      (recur right left (1- steps)))))
(export triangular swapped)

valid.name: exception-control-flow
valid.source:
(defun recover (value)
  (try
    (if value value (throw "missing"))
    (catch error (str "caught:" error))
    (finally (print "done"))))
(defasync settle (promise)
  (try (await promise)
    (catch error error)
    (finally (await promise))))
(export recover settle)

valid.name: vector-binding-patterns
valid.source:
(defportable pair-sum ([left right]) (+ left right))
(defun unpack ([first [second nil third] &rest tail] &optional [fallback])
  (let* (([head &rest rest] tail) ([nested] [fallback]))
    [first second third tail fallback head rest nested]))
(defun recover ()
  (try (throw [7 "caught"])
    (catch [code message] [code message])))
(export pair-sum unpack recover)

valid.name: map-binding-patterns
valid.source:
(defportable map-name ({:keys [name]}) name)
(defun unpack ({:keys [name age] :or {age 18} :as row})
  [name age row])
(defun nested ({alias :name {:keys [city]} :profile}) [alias city])
(defun shortcuts ({:keys [profile/name] :account/keys [id] :strs [label] :syms [token] :or {id 7}})
  [name id label token])
(defun recover ()
  (try (throw (js-object :code 7))
    (catch {:keys [code]} code)))
(export map-name unpack nested shortcuts recover)

valid.name: object-primitives
valid.source:
(defun objects (value key)
  [(object-keys value)
   (object-has? value key)
   (object-assoc value key 1)])
(export objects)
